naming.sets: <Scope> <Purpose>, up to 35 characters. Scope first so the Load study set menu groups sets together.
naming.studies: <Scope>_<What>. JBravo_ marks the J Bravo method.

horizons.label: Intraday
horizons.blurb: Minutes to hours, flat by the close.

horizons.label: Exits and reversals
horizons.blurb: Take profit or spot a bounce.

sets.name: Day Opening Range Breakout
sets.chart: 5 min, regular session; at least 2 days loaded
sets.goal: Trade the opening range breakout
sets.use: The first 30 minutes (09:30 to 10:00 ET) have set a range and you want to trade the break.
sets.signal: After 10:00 and before 15:30, the first close of the day above the opening-range high while above VWAP, in a daily uptrend, with time-of-day relative volume above 1.5 and SPY above its 20-day average. Short is the mirror. Stop at the middle of the range, target 2R, flat by the close.
read: Before 10:00 the label stays gray: the range is still forming.
The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = long conditions align, red = short, gray = wait (a valid answer).
An arrow marks the trigger bar. Enter only after that bar closes.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit. The size label gives shares for your riskPerTrade.
In the lower pane, you want bright bars and a rising cyan flow line in the trade direction. Dark bars mean momentum is fading.
sets.avoid: Pre-market breaks, thin symbols, wicks that never close beyond the range, and a daily trend pointing the other way.
sets.differs: Time-boxed to the open. Prior Day High-Low Break uses yesterday's range and can fire any time of day.

sets.name: Day Prior Day High-Low Break
sets.goal: Trade a break of yesterday's high or low
sets.use: Price pushes through yesterday's regular-session high or low.
sets.signal: The first close of the day beyond the prior-day extreme during regular hours, on the right side of VWAP, in a matching daily trend, with time-of-day relative volume above 1.5. Stop one ATR back through the level, target 2R.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = long conditions align, red = short, gray = wait (a valid answer).
An arrow marks the trigger bar. Enter only after that bar closes.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit. The size label gives shares for your riskPerTrade.
In the lower pane, you want bright bars and a rising cyan flow line in the trade direction. Dark bars mean momentum is fading.
Day_Volume_Profile draws today's profile at the right edge and yesterday's POC (yellow) and value area (dashed). A break that also leaves yesterday's value area is stronger.
sets.avoid: Gaps already far beyond the level, low-volume first tests, closes back inside yesterday's range.
sets.differs: Uses a level every trader sees. Opening Range Breakout is limited to the first 30 minutes.

sets.name: Day Trend Pullback to VWAP
sets.goal: Buy a dip (or sell a bounce) inside an intraday trend
sets.use: A clean intraday trend is running and you want to enter on a pullback instead of chasing.
sets.signal: A bullish 9/20/50 EMA stack, ADX above 20, DMI and money flow agree, price above VWAP, a test near the 20 EMA, then a reclaim of the 9 EMA. Short is the mirror.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = long conditions align, red = short, gray = wait (a valid answer).
An arrow marks the trigger bar. Enter only after that bar closes.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit. The size label gives shares for your riskPerTrade.
In the lower pane, you want bright bars and a rising cyan flow line in the trade direction. Dark bars mean momentum is fading.
sets.avoid: ADX below 20, repeated VWAP crossings, money flow disagreeing with the trend.
sets.differs: The only trend entry that waits for a pullback. The breakout sets enter as price extends.

sets.name: Day Squeeze Breakout
sets.goal: Trade a breakout from a quiet, tight range
sets.use: The market went quiet and tight (Bollinger Bands inside Keltner Channels) and is now expanding.
sets.signal: Within 5 bars after the squeeze releases, a close above the prior 20-bar high with MACD positive and the bar's volume above 1.5 times the same bar on recent days. Short is the mirror. Target 2R.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = long conditions align, red = short, gray = wait (a valid answer).
An arrow marks the trigger bar. Enter only after that bar closes.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit. The size label gives shares for your riskPerTrade.
In the lower pane, you want bright bars and a rising cyan flow line in the trade direction. Dark bars mean momentum is fading.
sets.avoid: An unreleased squeeze, a breakout with no participation, chasing more than a few ATRs past the trigger.
sets.differs: Needs a prior squeeze. Volume Spike Breakout needs none but is rarer and faster.

sets.name: Day Volume Spike Breakout
sets.goal: Catch a move on a sudden burst of volume
sets.use: A news bar or sudden volume surge is breaking out of the last 10 bars.
sets.signal: Bar volume more than 3 times the same bar on recent days, range above 1.2 ATR, a close near the bar's extreme, above VWAP and above the 10-bar high. Target 2R.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = long conditions align, red = short, gray = wait (a valid answer).
An arrow marks the trigger bar. Enter only after that bar closes.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit. The size label gives shares for your riskPerTrade.
In the lower pane, you want bright bars and a rising cyan flow line in the trade direction. Dark bars mean momentum is fading.
sets.avoid: Halts, opening-auction distortions, one-off news bars with no follow-through. Volume alone does not give direction.
sets.differs: The fastest and riskiest breakout set: late entries are common. Wait for follow-through on very large bars.

sets.name: Day Fade Back to VWAP
sets.goal: Fade an overextended move back to VWAP
sets.use: A range-bound day (ADX below 18) and price has stretched far from VWAP.
sets.signal: After 10:00 on a range day, price was outside the 2 standard deviation VWAP band and closes back inside while RSI is stretched. Only when the band is at least 1.5 bar ATRs from VWAP. Target is VWAP.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = long conditions align, red = short, gray = wait (a valid answer).
An arrow marks the trigger bar. Enter only after that bar closes.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit. The size label gives shares for your riskPerTrade.
In the lower pane, you want bright bars and a rising cyan flow line in the trade direction. Dark bars mean momentum is fading.
sets.avoid: ADX at or above 18, news shocks, trend days, and treating a band touch alone as a signal.
sets.differs: The only counter-trend set. Stop using it as soon as the day starts to trend.

sets.name: Day Value Area Rejection
sets.goal: Trade rejections at the edge of value
sets.use: Price probes the edge of today's value area (where 70% of volume traded) and fails.
sets.signal: Price trades at or below the prior session's value area low and closes back above it with a positive candle and positive money flow, while still below the prior POC. Mirror at the value area high. Target the prior POC. Fixed levels, so it does not repaint.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = long conditions align, red = short, gray = wait (a valid answer).
An arrow marks the trigger bar. Enter only after that bar closes.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit. The size label gives shares for your riskPerTrade.
In the lower pane, you want bright bars and a rising cyan flow line in the trade direction. Dark bars mean momentum is fading.
Today's profile is drawn at the right edge. Leave 25 or more bars of empty space on the right.
sets.avoid: Assuming the POC predicts direction, unreliable volume feeds, trading before the session profile has matured (the first 1 to 2 hours).
sets.differs: Targets the POC and works best on balanced days. The profile moves until the session closes, so earlier arrows can revise.

sets.name: Day Order Flow Turning Points
sets.goal: Find turning points from volume and order flow
sets.use: You have a trade idea and want volume and order flow to time it, or you want to catch a reversal early.
sets.signal: Yellow dot = early turn (price at a 20-bar extreme while momentum and flow disagree). Cyan or orange dot = early turn at VWAP or yesterday's POC or value area edge. Arrow = confirmed turn when momentum crosses zero.
read: Bars are a volume-weighted MACD. Bright = building, dark = fading.
The line is estimated order flow (buying minus selling volume over 14 bars). Above zero = net buying. Cyan = improving, magenta = worsening.
A dot is a warning, not an entry. Enter on the arrow, or on a break of the dot bar's high or low while flow agrees.
Labels show FLOW, MOM and RSI, where price is vs VWAP and yesterday's value, and WATCH LONG or WATCH SHORT while a dot waits for confirmation.
sets.avoid: Dots against a strong trend (histogram and flow both pinned to one side): the turn is usually a pause. Flow is estimated from where each bar closes, not real tape data.
sets.differs: A reading tool, not a rules-based setup. It is also the lower pane of every other Day set.

sets.name: Day Options Gamma Levels
sets.chart: 5 or 15 min; options-liquid symbols (SPY, QQQ, large caps)
sets.goal: Use option strikes as intraday levels
sets.use: Large optionable names, where dealer hedging can pin price or add to moves.
sets.signal: A directional entry from the daily trend, VWAP, DMI and relative volume. The call wall, put wall and gamma flip are context and do not trigger the arrow.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = long conditions align, red = short, gray = wait (a valid answer).
An arrow marks the trigger bar. Enter only after that bar closes.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit. The size label gives shares for your riskPerTrade.
In the lower pane, you want bright bars and a rising cyan flow line in the trade direction. Dark bars mean momentum is fading.
Options_Gamma_OI_Walls draws the call wall, put wall and gamma flip for the next monthly expiration. Look for price stalling at a wall or accepting beyond it.
sets.avoid: Treating the walls as certain support or resistance: they come from one expiration and 15 sampled strikes with an assumed sign.
sets.differs: Adds option levels to a trend entry. The levels never trigger anything.

sets.name: Day Short Setups
sets.goal: Look for short setups intraday
sets.use: Price pokes above a recent high and closes back below it.
sets.signal: Price trades above the prior 20-bar high but closes back below it, below its open, on volume above normal, in the lower 35% of the bar. A red arrow needs the input borrowConfirmed set to yes.
read: An orange wedge means setup only: the pattern is there but borrow is not confirmed.
Red arrows appear only when borrowConfirmed is yes and no squeeze risk is flagged.
The cover level is the broken 20-bar high plus about half an ATR.
In the lower pane, you want bright bars and a rising cyan flow line in the trade direction. Dark bars mean momentum is fading.
sets.avoid: Hard-to-borrow shares, news, halts, acquisition risk, high short interest. Short-stock loss is unlimited.
sets.differs: To use other short setups, open the gear and change setup (O05 breakdown, O06 pullback, O09 gap fade).

sets.name: Day JBravo Trend
sets.goal: Follow the J Bravo method intraday
sets.use: You follow the J Bravo moving-average method on a short timeframe.
sets.signal: A green BUY arrow on the first full candle body above the 9 SMA, with price not in a purple band.
read: Trade only in the direction of VWAP: long above it.
GoGo Juice (VWAP crossing the 20 EMA) starts the intraday move.
Take profit when a 9 prints or price reaches the purple band. Exit on a close below the 20 EMA.
The checklist labels should be mostly green before you enter.
sets.avoid: Sideways days: rules whipsaw on 1-minute charts.
sets.differs: A different method (moving averages and the 9 count) from the setup-signal sets.

sets.name: Swing Trend Pullback
sets.goal: Buy pullbacks in a daily uptrend
sets.use: A stock is in a long uptrend and has dipped to its 20-day average.
sets.signal: 20 > 50 > 200 EMA, price above the 50, RSI between 40 and 70, positive money flow, then a close back above the 20 EMA after touching near it. Short is the mirror. Exits: stop (max 3 ATRs), 3R target or a close below the prior 10-day low. No entry within 5 days of earnings or when SPY is below its 50-day.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = conditions align, red = they do not, gray = wait.
Arrows mark the trigger bar. Act on the daily close, not the live bar.
A red dashed line is the invalidation guide.
JBravo_SR_Levels draws blue support and purple resistance from confirmed swing pivots. Prefer entries just above support; be careful just under resistance.
sets.avoid: A flat 200-day average, money flow disagreeing, buying a gap far above the 20 EMA.
sets.differs: The default swing set: lower risk than a breakout but fewer signals.

sets.name: Swing Breakout
sets.goal: Trade a 20-day breakout
sets.use: Price closes at a new 20-day high or low.
sets.signal: A close beyond the previous 20-day high or low, 50-day slope in agreement, ADX above 18 and relative volume above 1.2. Exits: stop (max 3 ATRs), 3R target or a close below the prior 10-day low. No entry within 5 days of earnings or when SPY is below its 50-day.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = conditions align, red = they do not, gray = wait.
Arrows mark the trigger bar. Act on the daily close, not the live bar.
A red dashed line is the invalidation guide.
JBravo_SR_Levels draws blue support and purple resistance from confirmed swing pivots. Prefer entries just above support; be careful just under resistance.
sets.avoid: Intraday-only breaks, low-volume breaks, choppy ranges (many small losses).
sets.differs: A shorter channel than the 55-day trend breakout (setup D03): more signals, more false breaks.

sets.name: Swing Squeeze Breakout
sets.goal: Trade a breakout after a volatility squeeze
sets.use: Volatility has compressed and is releasing.
sets.signal: A closing 20-day breakout within 5 sessions after the squeeze releases, with the 50/200 regime, MACD and volume confirming. Exits: stop (max 3 ATRs), 3R target or a close below the prior 10-day low. No entry within 5 days of earnings or when SPY is below its 50-day.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = conditions align, red = they do not, gray = wait.
Arrows mark the trigger bar. Act on the daily close, not the live bar.
A red dashed line is the invalidation guide.
JBravo_SR_Levels draws blue support and purple resistance from confirmed swing pivots. Prefer entries just above support; be careful just under resistance.
sets.avoid: Trading while compression is still active, or treating volatility expansion as bullish by itself.
sets.differs: Needs a recent squeeze. The plain breakout set does not.

sets.name: Swing Oversold Bounce
sets.goal: Buy a short-term oversold dip in an uptrend
sets.use: A strong stock has dropped hard for a few days while its 200-day trend is still up.
sets.signal: RSI(2) was below 10 in an uptrend, then a close above the prior day's high. Exit on a close above the 5-day EMA or after 10 days. No entry within 5 days of earnings.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = conditions align, red = they do not, gray = wait.
Arrows mark the trigger bar. Act on the daily close, not the live bar.
A red dashed line is the invalidation guide.
JBravo_SR_Levels draws blue support and purple resistance from confirmed swing pivots. Prefer entries just above support; be careful just under resistance.
sets.avoid: Using it against the 200-day trend, treating oversold as a bottom, holding through unbounded event risk.
sets.differs: The only mean-reversion swing set: it trades against the short-term move but with the long-term trend.

sets.name: Swing Momentum Continuation
sets.goal: Ride a trend with momentum and money flow
sets.use: An established trend with improving momentum and money flow.
sets.signal: The 50/200 regime is bullish, MACD crosses above its signal, money flow is positive and on-balance volume confirms. Short is the mirror. Exits: stop (max 3 ATRs), 3R target or a close below the prior 10-day low. No entry within 5 days of earnings or when SPY is below its 50-day.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = conditions align, red = they do not, gray = wait.
Arrows mark the trigger bar. Act on the daily close, not the live bar.
A red dashed line is the invalidation guide.
JBravo_SR_Levels draws blue support and purple resistance from confirmed swing pivots. Prefer entries just above support; be careful just under resistance.
sets.avoid: Range-bound MACD whipsaws, counting MACD and moving averages as independent evidence.
sets.differs: Needs three confirmations, so it fires later than the pullback set.

sets.name: Swing Relative Strength Leaders
sets.goal: Find stocks stronger than the market
sets.use: You are screening a watchlist for the strongest names.
sets.signal: Price is in a bull regime, the stock's ratio to the benchmark is above its 50-day average, and price makes a 20-day breakout on normal or better volume. Exits: stop (max 3 ATRs), 3R target or a close below the prior 10-day low. No entry within 5 days of earnings or when SPY is below its 50-day.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = conditions align, red = they do not, gray = wait.
Arrows mark the trigger bar. Act on the daily close, not the live bar.
A red dashed line is the invalidation guide.
JBravo_SR_Levels draws blue support and purple resistance from confirmed swing pivots. Prefer entries just above support; be careful just under resistance.
Change the benchmark input when SPY is not the right comparison.
sets.avoid: Reading underperformance as a short thesis. It is a tactical signal, not a fundamental one.
sets.differs: Compares the stock to the market, not to its own history. Load it across a watchlist.

sets.name: Swing Trend with IV Risk Check
sets.goal: Swing trade with a check on option pricing
sets.use: You plan to use options or want to avoid event risk.
sets.signal: A trend and money-flow entry on a 20 EMA reclaim, blocked when implied volatility is above 1.3 times 20-day historical volatility. Missing IV does not block. Exits: stop (max 3 ATRs), 3R target or a close below the prior 10-day low. No entry within 5 days of earnings or when SPY is below its 50-day.
read: The setup study prints a cyan label naming the setup. Green = conditions align, red = they do not, gray = wait.
Arrows mark the trigger bar. Act on the daily close, not the live bar.
A red dashed line is the invalidation guide.
The gamma walls show where option positions cluster. An IV/HV ratio above 1.5 means options price an event: not bearish, but expensive.
sets.avoid: Choosing direction from implied volatility. Stale or missing IV is not confirmation.
sets.differs: The IV gate is what separates it from the plain pullback set.

sets.name: Swing Short Setups
sets.goal: Look for short setups on daily charts
sets.use: Price breaks below a falling 50/200 average with volume.
sets.signal: Below a falling 50/200 regime, a close below the prior 20-bar low, relative volume above 1.2 and negative money flow. Red arrows need borrowConfirmed set to yes.
read: An orange wedge means setup only; red needs borrow confirmed and no squeeze risk.
The invalidation is the prior 10-bar low plus about one ATR.
JBravo_SR_Levels draws blue support and purple resistance from confirmed swing pivots. Prefer entries just above support; be careful just under resistance.
sets.avoid: Hard-to-borrow shares, news, halts, high short interest. Short-stock loss is unlimited.
sets.differs: Open the gear and change setup for O06 (failed bounce) or O08 (distribution).

sets.name: Swing JBravo Trend
sets.goal: Follow the J Bravo method over days to weeks
sets.use: You hold positions for days to weeks using the J Bravo rules.
sets.signal: A green BUY arrow (first full candle above the 9 SMA) with price above the 200 and 9 > 20 > 180.
read: Trend: price above the white 200 with 9 > 20 > 180.
Entry: the BUY arrow, better just above support with MACD above its signal.
Stop under the entry candle or the nearest blue support.
Exit on a red SELL arrow (close below the 20 EMA) or at purple resistance.
sets.avoid: Intraday timeframes under 5 minutes.
sets.differs: Moving-average rules plus the 100-week and 200-week lines.

sets.name: Invest Trend Regime
sets.chart: Daily or weekly; load on SPY first
sets.goal: Know whether the long-term trend is up
sets.use: You decide whether to hold or reduce a position.
sets.signal: Hold while price is above a rising 200-day, the 50-day is above the 200-day and money flow is positive. A reclaim of the 50-day is the entry trigger. Reduce on a close below the 200-day.
read: Reviewed weekly or monthly, not daily. A green label means hold or accumulate, red means reduce, gray means wait.
The arrow marks the first completed bar where the rule changed. Monthly rules (L02, L10) change only on the first bar of a month.
JBravo_LongTerm_MAs draws the 100-week and 200-week lines: the big-picture floor or ceiling.
Position size, valuation and portfolio risk are not in the study.
sets.avoid: Treating a golden cross as a guaranteed entry, and ignoring valuation and concentration.
sets.differs: The simplest filter. Momentum adds a monthly return rule.

sets.name: Invest Momentum
sets.goal: Hold only what has 12-month momentum
sets.use: You want a monthly rule: own what has risen over the last 12 months.
sets.signal: Hold when the 252-day return is positive, price is above the 200-day and SPY is in an uptrend. Checked on the first bar of each month; an arrow appears only when the position changes.
read: Reviewed weekly or monthly, not daily. A green label means hold or accumulate, red means reduce, gray means wait.
The arrow marks the first completed bar where the rule changed. Monthly rules (L02, L10) change only on the first bar of a month.
JBravo_LongTerm_MAs draws the 100-week and 200-week lines: the big-picture floor or ceiling.
Position size, valuation and portfolio risk are not in the study.
sets.avoid: Treating historical evidence as a forecast: trend following whipsaws after reversals.
sets.differs: The strongest academic backing and the slowest signal.

sets.name: Invest Buy the Pullback
sets.goal: Add to a long-term winner on a dip
sets.use: A long-term winner is retreating toward its 50-day average.
sets.signal: A close back above the 50-day after testing it, in an uptrend with RSI between 40 and 65 and positive money flow.
read: Reviewed weekly or monthly, not daily. A green label means hold or accumulate, red means reduce, gray means wait.
The arrow marks the first completed bar where the rule changed. Monthly rules (L02, L10) change only on the first bar of a month.
JBravo_LongTerm_MAs draws the 100-week and 200-week lines: the big-picture floor or ceiling.
Position size, valuation and portfolio risk are not in the study.
sets.avoid: Averaging into a falling 200-day trend, assuming every touch of the 50-day is support.
sets.differs: Entry timing only. Pair it with Market Leaders to choose the stock.

sets.name: Invest Market Leaders
sets.chart: Daily or weekly; benchmark defaults to SPY
sets.goal: Pick market leaders to own
sets.use: You are choosing which stocks to own.
sets.signal: Price and the benchmark are both in uptrends, the stock's ratio to SPY is above its 100-day average, then the ratio makes a new 252-day high.
read: Reviewed weekly or monthly, not daily. A green label means hold or accumulate, red means reduce, gray means wait.
The arrow marks the first completed bar where the rule changed. Monthly rules (L02, L10) change only on the first bar of a month.
JBravo_LongTerm_MAs draws the 100-week and 200-week lines: the big-picture floor or ceiling.
Position size, valuation and portfolio risk are not in the study.
Change the benchmark for a sector or country comparison.
sets.avoid: Mistaking relative outperformance for a positive absolute return.
sets.differs: Compares a stock to the market. Quality and Growth adds company fundamentals.

sets.name: Invest Quality and Growth
sets.chart: Daily or weekly; company stocks, not ETFs
sets.goal: Screen for quality and growth
sets.use: You want an uptrend backed by company fundamentals.
sets.signal: Positive free cash flow per share, return on equity, gross margin and earnings, then a close above the prior 126-day high. Shows FUNDAMENTALS N/A when data is missing.
read: Reviewed weekly or monthly, not daily. A green label means hold or accumulate, red means reduce, gray means wait.
The arrow marks the first completed bar where the rule changed. Monthly rules (L02, L10) change only on the first bar of a month.
JBravo_LongTerm_MAs draws the 100-week and 200-week lines: the big-picture floor or ceiling.
Position size, valuation and portfolio risk are not in the study.
sets.avoid: ETFs or symbols with missing fundamentals; accounting data is delayed and varies by sector.
sets.differs: The only long-term set that uses fundamentals.

sets.name: Invest Accumulation
sets.goal: Spot accumulation before a breakout
sets.use: You want volume to confirm a breakout in an uptrend.
sets.signal: Volume flow, on-balance volume and money flow all positive, then a close above the prior 126-day high.
read: Reviewed weekly or monthly, not daily. A green label means hold or accumulate, red means reduce, gray means wait.
The arrow marks the first completed bar where the rule changed. Monthly rules (L02, L10) change only on the first bar of a month.
JBravo_LongTerm_MAs draws the 100-week and 200-week lines: the big-picture floor or ceiling.
Position size, valuation and portfolio risk are not in the study.
sets.avoid: Reading the proxies as proof of institutional buying.
sets.differs: A price-volume confirmation, not an early warning.

sets.name: Options Dealer Exposure
sets.goal: See dealer positioning and gamma levels
sets.use: You want the big picture of option positioning for a symbol.
sets.signal: Not a trade trigger. Positive net gamma suggests price pinning, negative suggests larger moves. Walls mark likely stalls.
read: GEX is the modeled change in hedging for a 1% move; DEX is the delta of the sampled open interest.
Walls and the gamma flip are drawn on the chart for the next monthly expiration.
Treat everything as conditional context.
sets.avoid: Reading it as actual dealer inventory. It uses one expiration and 15 sampled strikes with an assumed call-positive, put-negative sign.
sets.differs: The overview set. The other Options sets are narrower.

sets.name: Options 0DTE Exposure
sets.goal: Read same-day (0DTE) option exposure
sets.use: You trade intraday on days with same-day expiration.
sets.signal: Not a trade trigger. Shows today's open-interest exposure and gross gamma turnover from same-day volume.
read: Open-interest exposure uses the latest daily snapshot, so it misses contracts opened and closed today.
Gross turnover is unsigned activity, not net market-maker exposure.
sets.avoid: Believing high 0DTE volume means high net risk: call and put volume have no buy/sell or open/close side.
sets.differs: Same layout as Dealer Exposure but for today's expiration.

sets.name: Options Open Interest Change
sets.goal: See where option positions are growing
sets.use: You want to see whether positions are being opened or closed.
sets.signal: Not a trade trigger. Price up with open interest up suggests new positions; price up with open interest down suggests covering.
read: Shows sampled call, put and total open-interest change from the previous daily snapshot.
Every contract has one buyer and one seller, so open interest alone cannot say who is buying.
sets.avoid: Calling an increase bullish or bearish on its own.
sets.differs: Positioning change over a day; the other options sets show level and exposure.

sets.name: Any JBravo Reversal Watch
sets.goal: Take profits or spot a bounce on any timeframe
sets.use: You hold a position and want to know when to take profit, or you are looking for a bounce.
sets.signal: Top risk: a 9 count up, purple candles, price in the purple band, price at purple resistance, MVP turning down from its high band. Bounce is the mirror in blue.
read: Two or three signals together justify taking profit or watching for an entry.
One signal alone is not enough.
Never trade a reversal against a strong trend wedge on one signal.
sets.avoid: Trading a reversal against a strong trend.
sets.differs: A combination view for exits and bounces. The Day and Swing JBravo sets are for entries.

sets.name: Any JBravo Full Toolkit
sets.goal: Review everything J Bravo teaches
sets.use: You are learning the method or reviewing a chart in depth.
sets.signal: All J Bravo signals together. Busy on small charts.
read: Start with the checklist: enter only when most items are green.
Then use the Day or Swing JBravo sets for actual trading.
sets.avoid: Using it on small charts: it is crowded.
sets.differs: Everything in the other JBravo sets at once.

sets.name: Any Trend Levels Context
sets.chart: daily, or intraday with about a year loaded
sets.goal: See the trend across daily, weekly and monthly averages
sets.use: Before any trade, or when you want to know how strong a trend is and where it may stall.
sets.signal: Not a trade trigger. A score out of 5 counts how many of the daily 20/50/200, 20-week and 20-month averages price is above. Dots mark a close through the 200-day, 20-week or 20-month average.
read: Score 5 = full uptrend, 0 = full downtrend, in between = mixed.
A first touch of a major average often holds; a close through it often starts a move that way.
Distances are in daily ATRs: more than 6 ATRs from the 200-day is stretched.
sets.avoid: Treating a dot as an entry. Confirm with a signal set.
sets.differs: Context only, no entries. Uses fixed daily, weekly and monthly averages on any chart.

sets.name: Any Trend and Gamma Context
sets.chart: daily, or intraday with about a year loaded
sets.goal: See trend levels and the option gamma regime together
sets.use: On optionable symbols, to judge whether moves are likely to extend or revert.
sets.signal: Not a trade trigger. Adds the call wall, put wall and gamma flip. Positive net gamma suggests mean reversion and pinning; negative suggests moves extend.
read: Score 5 = full uptrend, 0 = full downtrend, in between = mixed.
A first touch of a major average often holds; a close through it often starts a move that way.
Distances are in daily ATRs: more than 6 ATRs from the 200-day is stretched.
Price above the gamma flip with positive gamma: expect smaller, reverting moves. Below it: expect larger moves.
sets.avoid: Treating a dot as an entry. Confirm with a signal set.
sets.differs: Adds the option regime to the trend levels. Needs an optionable symbol.

sets.name: Help Setups Manual
sets.goal: Learn what the signals mean and their limits
sets.use: You want the explanations on the chart.
sets.signal: No signals. Labels explain the setups, the data limits and how to read open interest and short positions.
read: Click the study gear and change setup (M00 to M06) to switch pages.
sets.avoid: Nothing: it draws labels only.
sets.differs: Reading material, not a trading set.

studies.name: Day_Setup_Signals
studies.what: Signal study. Ten intraday entry setups behind one setup input.
legend: Cyan label = the selected setup.
Green = long (or accumulate) conditions align. Red = short or reduce. Gray = conditions incomplete: a valid answer.
Green and red arrows = the trigger bar. Wait for the bar to close.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit, gray dot = signal blocked (earnings or market filter). The size label gives shares for riskPerTrade dollars.
A gray LINES: label names every colored line.

studies.name: Day_Flow_Momentum
studies.what: Context study. Volume-weighted MACD, estimated order flow, and early and confirmed turning points.
legend: Bars: bright = momentum building, dark = fading.
Line: estimated buying minus selling volume over 14 bars, scaled -3 to +3. Cyan = improving, magenta = worsening.
Dots: early turn. Yellow = in open space, cyan or orange = at VWAP or yesterday's POC or value area edge.
Arrows: confirmed turn (momentum crosses zero within 10 bars of a dot).
Labels: FLOW, MOM with RSI, location vs VWAP and prior value, WATCH LONG or SHORT.

studies.name: Day_Volume_Profile
studies.what: Context study. Today's volume profile at the right edge, plus yesterday's POC and value area.
legend: Histogram at the right edge = today's volume by price. Needs 25+ bars of empty space (Chart Settings, Time axis, Expansion area).
Yellow line = yesterday's POC (price with the most volume). Dashed lines = yesterday's value area high and low (70% of volume).
Label: price above prior value (buyers accepted higher prices), below (sellers in control) or inside (balance, fade the edges).
On daily charts: one profile of the visible range.

legend: Cyan label = the selected setup.
Green = long (or accumulate) conditions align. Red = short or reduce. Gray = conditions incomplete: a valid answer.
Green and red arrows = the trigger bar. Wait for the bar to close.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit, gray dot = signal blocked (earnings or market filter). The size label gives shares for riskPerTrade dollars.

studies.name: Any_Short_Setup_Signals
studies.what: Signal study. Short setups, order-flow context and squeeze risk.
legend: Cyan label = the selected setup.
Green = long (or accumulate) conditions align. Red = short or reduce. Gray = conditions incomplete: a valid answer.
Green and red arrows = the trigger bar. Wait for the bar to close.
Red dash = stop, green dash = target, white square = exit, gray dot = signal blocked (earnings or market filter). The size label gives shares for riskPerTrade dollars.
A gray LINES: label names every colored line.
Orange wedge = setup only (borrow not confirmed). Red arrows need borrowConfirmed = yes and no squeeze risk.

studies.name: Options_Greeks_Exposure
studies.what: Context study. Dealer exposure pages built from the option chain: GEX, DEX, zero levels, 0DTE, vanna and charm, vega/theta/rho, open-interest change.
legend: Labels show the numbers for the selected page.
Levels (when shown) are model estimates from one expiration and sampled strikes.
The expiration defaults to the next monthly (third Friday) and rolls automatically.

studies.name: Options_Gamma_OI_Walls
studies.what: Context study. Call wall, put wall and gamma flip on the price chart.
legend: Call wall = strike with the largest modeled call gamma or open interest: likely resistance or pin.
Put wall = the same for puts: likely support.
Gamma flip = where modeled net gamma changes sign: above it price tends to pin, below it moves can extend.
Single expiration and 15 sampled strikes under a call-positive, put-negative convention: an estimate.

studies.name: Any_Trend_Levels
studies.what: Context study. Daily 20/50/200, 20-week and 20-month averages with a trend score and dots where a major level breaks.
legend: Green 20D, yellow 50D, white 200D, cyan dash 20W, magenta dash 20M.
Cyan dot = close up through 200D/20W/20M. Orange dot = close down through one.
Score label: how many of the 5 averages price is above.

studies.name: Day_Strategy, Swing_Strategy, Invest_Strategy
studies.what: Backtest versions of the signal studies, generated from the same code. Add one, pick the same setup, then right-click a trade marker and choose Show report.
legend: Green LE / red SE = simulated entries; white LX / SX = exits.
Entries fill at the next bar's open; stops and targets at their level. No commission or slippage.
Keep a setup only with 30+ trades over several symbols and profit factor above 1.3.

studies.name: Help_Setups_Manual
studies.what: On-chart explanations of the signals and data limits.
legend: Change the setup input (M00 to M06) to switch pages.

studies.name: JBravo_Checklist
studies.what: Six live green or red checks and an exit reminder.
legend: Enter only when most items are green.

studies.name: JBravo_Trend_MAs
studies.what: 9 SMA, 20 EMA, 180 SMA, 200 SMA with BUY and SELL arrows and strong-trend wedges.
legend: BUY = first full candle body above the 9. SELL = close below the 20 EMA.
Lime or magenta wedge = start of a strong trend (9 > 20 > 180, all rising, or the mirror).
Cyan or yellow dots = GoGo Juice (VWAP crossing the 20 EMA), intraday only.

studies.name: JBravo_9_Count
studies.what: A 9 count, and purple candles when price is stretched.
legend: A 9 means the move is tired.
Purple candles mean stretched: do not chase, consider taking profit.

studies.name: JBravo_Bands
studies.what: Purple cloud above price, blue cloud below.
legend: Price in the purple cloud: a drop may come. In the blue cloud: a bounce may come.

studies.name: JBravo_LongTerm_MAs
legend: The big-picture floor or ceiling. Shown on daily and weekly charts only.

studies.name: JBravo_SR_Levels
studies.what: Support and resistance from confirmed swing pivots.
legend: Blue = support, purple = resistance. Solid = newest, dashed = previous.
A level disappears once price closes through it.

studies.name: JBravo_MVP_Oscillator
studies.what: RSI with standard-deviation reversal bands and arrows.
legend: Green arrow = turning up out of the low band. Magenta = turning down from the high band.
Use as confirmation only.

standard.name: VWAP
standard.answers: Where is the average price paid today, and who is in control?
standard.read: Above VWAP buyers control, below sellers. The +/-2 SD bands mark stretched prices. Resets each day.
standard.caution: Meaningless on daily charts and in the first minutes of the session.

standard.name: AnchoredVWAP
standard.answers: What is the average price paid since an event (earnings, a low, a breakout)?
standard.read: Anchor it at the event. Price above = holders since then are in profit.
standard.caution: The result depends entirely on the anchor date.

standard.name: Moving averages (20, 50, 200)
standard.answers: What is the trend, and where might a pullback end?
standard.read: Price above a rising 200 = uptrend. 20 > 50 > 200 = aligned. Pullbacks often stall near the 20 or 50.

standard.name: MACD
standard.read: The histogram above zero with the MACD above its signal is bullish momentum. A fading histogram warns before a cross.
standard.pair: Any setup study as a lower-pane check
standard.caution: Moves with RSI: they count as one vote, not two.

standard.name: RSI
standard.read: Above 70 stretched up, below 30 stretched down. In strong trends it stays pinned; use 40 to 60 as the pullback zone.
standard.caution: Overbought is not a sell signal by itself.

standard.name: Bollinger Bands
standard.read: Narrow bands = quiet. Closes outside a band usually continue first.
standard.caution: A band touch is not a reversal signal.

standard.name: Keltner Channels
standard.answers: How far is price from its average in ATR terms?
standard.read: Bollinger Bands inside Keltner Channels = squeeze. The release is the signal to watch.
standard.pair: Day Squeeze Breakout, Swing Squeeze Breakout
standard.caution: Needs a breakout to confirm direction.

standard.name: ATR
standard.answers: How big is a normal move? Where does a stop belong?
standard.read: Size stops and targets in ATR. Rising ATR = volatility expanding.
standard.pair: All setup studies (invalidation guides use ATR)

standard.name: ADX and DMI
standard.answers: Is there a trend, and which side is stronger?
standard.read: ADX above 20 = trending, below 18 = range. +DI above -DI = buyers stronger.
standard.pair: Day Trend Pullback to VWAP, Day Fade Back to VWAP

standard.name: Volume Profile
standard.answers: At which prices did the volume trade?
standard.read: POC = most volume. Value area = 70% of volume. Price above value = acceptance higher; rejection back into value is a fade setup.
standard.caution: The built-in default draws on top of the last bars if there is no empty space on the right.

standard.name: Relative Volume
standard.read: Above 2 standard deviations = a burst. Above about 1.2 times normal supports a breakout.
standard.caution: High volume alone does not say direction.

standard.name: Chaikin Money Flow
standard.read: Positive = buying pressure over the lookback. Used as a filter in most setups.
standard.caution: A proxy based on where bars close, not real order flow.

standard.name: On-Balance Volume
standard.answers: Does volume confirm the price trend?
standard.read: OBV rising with price confirms. OBV falling while price rises is a divergence.
standard.caution: Divergences can last a long time.

disclaimer: Educational only, not investment advice. Rules use only past data and have not been backtested for profit. Order flow is estimated from bar data, not real bid/ask volume.
